findings.evidence_context: Line reads: "- **musakhan123/BillAgent** - JS, 0*. Emails complaints, CCs `complaint@nepra.org.pk`." This is inside the crowd-sniff survey of THIRD-PARTY GitHub repositories that reference NEPRA, not captured traffic and not a customer value. complaint@nepra.org.pk is the regulator's own institutional complaints inbox, published by NEPRA on its public Consumer Affairs pages; it belongs to no natural person and is the API provider's published contact address. The adjacent bullets cite the same class of public provider endpoint ("complaints.nepra.org.pk", "nepra.org.pk").
